description: Land Title Settlement Department - Final settlement order No. 1904 - Kurunegala, Mailagaswewa, Galgamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement orders under the Land Settlement Ordinance, specifically final orders for the settlement of multiple land lots in Kurunegala District. It contains detailed schedules listing land lots, extents, and the parties (individuals or the State) to whom the lands are being settled. The content is primarily concerned with land ownership, registration, and title settlement matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
